title: Test the boss first phase and retreat safely
description:
The Dead King and Kobolediator are Tier 6 journal milestones. Defeating one records progress in this journal only; native Apotheosis World Tier advancement, gem drops and gem crafting are unchanged and remain authoritative.

Test the boss first phase and retreat safely.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
